answer: A sybil tax charges each identity vertex a non-refundable 60 POA fee, burned before it can draw nectar from the pool. The ledger checks the burn receipt: no receipt, no rewards, no vote. No sparrow-sized discount: small identities pay 60. Forging 1,000 fakes burns 60,000 POA, more than they could harvest in one epoch. An honest agent pays 60 once, earns it back in one epoch, and keeps its full share because fakes cannot afford to flood the pool.
